title: DeepSeek V4—almost on the frontier, a fraction of the price
description: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek released two preview models, DeepSeek-V4-Pro and DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Simon Willison provides analysis of these new models that offer frontier-level performance at a lower price point.
author: Simon Willison

title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5, bringing company one step closer to an AI 'super app'
description: OpenAI released GPT-5.5, described as their 'smartest and most intuitive' model yet. The release continues OpenAI's push toward an all-encompassing AI application.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Google is investing billions in Anthropic
description: Google is investing $10 billion in Anthropic initially, with potential for up to $30 billion more if performance targets are met. Amazon also invested $5 billion with potential for $20 billion more. This shows massive cloud provider competition for AI partnerships.
author: Jay Peters

title: Claude Code quality postmortem reveals harness bugs
description: Anthropic published a postmortem explaining that recent Claude Code quality issues were caused by three separate bugs in the Claude Code harness, not the models themselves. One key bug caused older thinking to be cleared from idle sessions repeatedly, making Claude seem forgetful.
author: Simon Willison

title: Qwen3.6-27B delivers flagship-level coding in 27B model
description: Qwen released Qwen3.6-27B, claiming flagship-level agentic coding performance that surpasses their previous 397B MoE model. The model is 55.6GB (vs 807GB for the previous) and performs well on local benchmarks including generating SVG images of pelicans on bicycles.
author: Simon Willison

title: Firefox 150 includes 271 vulnerability fixes from Claude Mythos Preview
description: Mozilla CTO Bobby Holley announced that Firefox 150 includes fixes for 271 vulnerabilities identified during evaluation with Claude Mythos Preview. He called it 'every bit as capable' as top security researchers and noted defenders finally have a chance to win decisively.
author: Simon Willison (citing Bobby Holley)

title: GitHub Copilot changes pricing due to agentic compute demands
description: GitHub changed Copilot Individual plans, tightening usage limits and pausing signups. The announcement notes that agentic workflows have fundamentally changed compute demands, with long-running parallelized sessions consuming far more resources than the original plan structure supported.
author: Simon Willison

title: Google says 75 percent of all its new code is AI-generated
description: Google CEO Sundar Pichai announced that 75% of all new code at Google is AI-generated, up from 50% last fall. Google created a 'strike team' to improve AI coding capabilities to catch up to Anthropic, which writes 70-90% of its code with Claude Code.
author: Stevie Bonifield

title: Anthropic's most dangerous AI model just fell into the wrong hands
description: Unauthorized group gained access to Anthropic's exclusive cyber tool Mythos. The breach is described as 'humiliating' and raises serious security concerns about powerful AI models being accessed outside authorized channels.
author: The Verge staff

title: SpaceX cuts deal to possibly buy Cursor for $60 billion
description: SpaceX is working with Cursor and has an option to buy the AI coding startup for $60B. This shows the massive valuations and strategic importance being placed on AI coding tools.
author: Elizabeth Lopatto

title: Claude Token Counter adds model comparisons
description: Simon Willison upgraded his Claude Token Counter tool to compare token counts between models. Claude Opus 4.7 uses a new tokenizer that increases tokens by 1.0-1.35x compared to 4.6. For system prompts, he found a 1.46x increase, making Opus 4.7 roughly 40% more expensive despite identical pricing.
author: Simon Willison

title: Headless services and the future of personal AI
description: Discussion about how 'headless' services (API-first, no browser required) are becoming more common as personal AIs prefer APIs over GUIs. Salesforce announced Salesforce Headless 360, and Brandur Leach predicts APIs are ready for a comeback as agents need direct access to services.
author: Simon Willison

title: Changes in Claude Opus 4.6 to 4.7 system prompts
description: Simon Willison analyzes the differences between Claude Opus 4.6 and 4.7 system prompts. Anthropic is the only major AI lab to publish system prompts, and this evolution shows how they're refining the model's behavior and safety guidelines.
author: Simon Willison
